battle.name: 宋滅北漢之戰
battle.brief: 太平興國四年二月，宋太宗趙光義御駕親征北漢，軍隊自晉陽出發，先在柏谷擊破契丹援軍，再進逼太原，築圍斷糧、穿地道、施攻城器，五月迫劉繼元出降，北漢亡。卡面羅馬短劍不會出現在河東戰場，但宋軍近戰所用的環首直刀與刀盾配合，正是與它同屬刺突型短兵刃的同類器物。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 宋滅北漢之戰是太平興國四年（979）北宋對山西北部割據政權北漢的滅國戰役，交戰三方是北宋、北漢與北漢的宗主國契丹（遼）。北漢於951年由後漢高祖劉知遠之弟劉崇在晉陽建立，疆域只佔山西北部數州，兵少民寡，國祚卻綿延近三十年，全賴契丹輸粟輸兵撐住。北漢的軍隊以劉崇收編的後晉降人與契丹舊部組成的拱衛軍為骨幹，外加各州鄉兵與少量邊地部眾，樞密院掌兵籍，侍衛近臣宿衛皇城，國主劉繼元總攬軍政，一方小朝廷的樣子卻做足。北宋一方是趙匡胤開國的中原王朝：趙光義976年即位，先平南唐、再於太平興國三年（978）滅北周，拆掉北漢最後的屏障，太平興國四年二月御駕親征；樞密院統籌兵糧，曹彬、潘美分當一路，楊業等宿將各率所部，河東各州供應糧草民夫，靠遠征大軍與龐大轉運隊把這條戰線拉長。契丹並未全程參與攻城，而是在北漢被圍前後出兵西援，並以宗主國身分向宋廷交涉責問。
countriesEn: The Song conquest of Northern Han was the war in which the Northern Song, in 979, destroyed the rump state of Northern Han in northern Shanxi; three parties appear on the field, the Song, Northern Han, and Northern Han's overlord, the Khitan Liao. Northern Han had been founded in 951 by Liu Chong, brother of the Later Han emperor Liu Zhiyuan, with its capital at Jinyang, in what is now Taiyuan. Its territory amounted to only a few prefectures in northern Shanxi, so scarce were its soldiers and its people, yet the state endured for nearly thirty years almost entirely on Khitan grain and Khitan troops. Northern Han's army was built on a core of the guard army Liu Chong drew from Later Jin defectors and former Khitan soldiers, supplemented by prefectural militia and a small number of frontier tribal contingents. The Privy Council controlled the muster rolls, palace guards watched the capital, and the ruler Liu Jiyuan held all military power in his own hands, so that a small state played the part of a full court. The other side was the Central Plain dynasty founded by Zhao Kuangyin. Zhao Guangyi had taken the throne in 976, destroyed Southern Tang and then in 978, at the end of Taiping Xingguo 3, wiped out Northern Zhou, removing the last screen in front of Northern Han. In the second month of Taiping Xingguo 4 he led the campaign in person: the Privy Council directed men and supplies, Cao Bin and Pan Mei led the two columns, veteran commanders such as Yang Ye brought their own contingents, and the prefectures of Hedong supplied grain and corvée labour, so that a far-reaching field army was held together by a vast transport service. The Khitan never took part in the siege as such; they sent an army west to relieve Northern Han while the city was already blockaded, and as overlord and guarantor of the northern state they pressed the Song court with diplomatic remonstrance.
people: 此役最具決定性的人物是宋太宗趙光義。他不假手於人，太平興國四年二月自京師出師，親率中軍北上，抵晉陽後駐紮城西，屢次登高觀敵陣，與諸將議定「先絕外援、再圖孤城」的次第，圍城最艱難的時候亦與將士同勞，穿地道一役更有御駕督促的記載。曹彬為主力統帥，最先迎擊自遼而來的援軍於柏谷，大破之，使北漢失去外援；潘美與曹彬並為行軍一員，參與築圍、造攻城器械與分路進逼；楊業年事已高，率部戍守西北一線，負責保障糧道與側翼，並牽制北漢的邊軍。北方之主劉繼元在位十九年，前期屢遣使議和，又急向契丹求援，兵臨城下仍想拖延，直至城中糧盡、援絕、人心崩解，才在五月開城出降，出降後授檢校太尉、封鄭王。北漢開國者劉崇已於954年病逝，無法親見亡國。遼方主政者承天蕭太后與遼軍諸將，主和與主戰之議並存，最終仍出兵西援。北漢城內是否有人暗中開城應宋，各書記載不一，姓名諸說並存，難以定論。
peopleEn: The decisive figure of this war was Emperor Taizong of Song, Zhao Guangyi. He did not entrust the campaign to anyone else: in the second month of Taiping Xingguo 4 he left the capital with the central army in person, moved north, and after reaching Jinyang pitched his camp west of the city. He repeatedly climbed high points to read the enemy position, and with his commanders settled on the order of operations, first cut off the foreign aid and only then take the isolated city. At the hardest moment of the blockade he laboured together with the soldiers, and the records even note the sovereign himself urging on the work of digging the tunnel. Cao Bin was the commander of the main force and the first to meet the Khitan relief army at Baigu, defeating it heavily and so depriving Northern Han of its outside support. Pan Mei served alongside Cao Bin as a column commander, taking part in the ring of entrenchments, the building of siege machines and the advance by several routes. Yang Ye, already old, held the northwestern line with his troops, securing the supply route and the flank while pinning down Northern Han's frontier garrison. The ruler of the north, Liu Jiyuan, had reigned for nineteen years; early in the war he sent envoys to ask for peace and begged the Khitan for help, and even with the enemy at his walls he strove to delay, until grain ran out in the city, relief ceased and morale collapsed, and only in the fifth month did he open the gates and surrender. He was afterwards made Grand Commander of the Palace and enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng. Liu Chong, the founder of Northern Han, had died of illness in 954 and could not see his state fall. On the Liao side, the regent Empress Dowager Chengtian and the Liao commanders argued both for peace and for war, and in the end an army did go west to the rescue. Whether anyone inside Northern Han secretly arranged to open the gates to the Song is reported differently from book to book, and the names involved remain a matter of conflicting accounts.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬短劍（Gladius）定於公元前100年前後，是羅馬步兵的標準近戰兵刃：直身、雙刃、帶護手，重心靠前，配大圓盾使用，刺突為主、劈砍為輔，短兵相接靠的是盾緣與出刺的節奏，而不是揮砍。它不可能出現在公元979年的河東戰場，但同一類短兵刃在中原另有傳承：漢晉之際流行的環首直刀，經唐人改稱橫刀、儀刀，至宋代仍是禁軍與各州軍配發的近身兵器，宋軍步卒常持刀與長槍、戟相配，築城、突門、登梯之際換以短刀，與之同行的還有皮盾、木盾。攻城一方用得上的器械在宋軍中大量存在：撞車、飛雲梯、砲車（投石機）、木柵、拒馬、鹿角與鐵蒺藜；圍城時又自城根掘進，以木樁支撐成地道，兩側填土加固。遠射用弓與弩，弓弩手列陣射擊掩體後的攻城者；守城一方倚靠城樓、雉堞、弓弩與投石，砸壞梯具、燒毀攻城器。糧秣靠牛車、驢騾與大批轉運夫役，從河東各州沿汾水與陸路運抵城下。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card, the Roman gladius, is dated to around 100 BC and was the standard close-combat arm of the Roman infantry: straight, double-edged, with a guard, its point of balance well forward, and it was used together with the large oval shield. The thrust was primary and the cut secondary; in close fighting it was the rim of the shield and the rhythm of the thrust that mattered, not swinging. It cannot have appeared on a battlefield in Hedong in the year 979, yet the same class of short blade had its own line of transmission in the Central Plain. The ring-pommel straight sword popular between Han and Jin was renamed by the Tang into the hengdao and the ceremonial blade, and by the Song it was still the close-quarter weapon issued to the imperial guards and to provincial troops. Song infantry commonly carried a sword together with long spear and halberd, and when storming walls, forcing gates or climbing ladders they switched to the short sword; alongside it went leather and wooden shields. The siege train available to the Song army was large: battering rams, scaling ladders, stone-throwing trebuchets, wooden palisades, caltrops and antler-shaped obstacles; during the blockade they also dug in at the foot of the wall, shoring the tunnel with timber piles and packing the sides with earth. Missiles were bow and crossbow, with archers and crossbowmen firing in line at sappers working behind cover; the defenders relied on gate towers, battlements, bows and thrown stones, smashing ladders and burning siege engines. Grain and provisions moved on ox carts, donkeys and mules, with a great multitude of corvée porters bringing food from the prefectures of Hedong by the Fen river and by road to the camps below the city.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術主軸是「先打援軍，再打孤城」。宋軍自晉陽出師，未急於直逼太原，而是先在柏谷迎擊自遼而來的援軍：步兵結方陣，弩手與弓手先手齊射，騎兵正面牽制，兩翼合擊，隨後追擊潰散之敵於山谷道路之間，逼其放棄與北漢的聯繫。援軍既去，宋軍分兵合圍晉陽，四面築木柵、掘壕溝，斷絕城內外往來，同時在城北、城東分置營壘，護住自河東運來的糧隊。攻城手段是多路並用：砲車先行，拋石打擊城樓與城頭守軍；飛雲梯與穴進逼近城牆；最費工的是穿地道，在城根附近掘進，以木樁支撐，兩側填土築成可供兵丁通行的通道，史書記述宋軍在城根穿地歷數十日而成。守方則閉城死守，以弓弩拒梯、以投石砸毀器械、夜間出兵襲營，試圖拖到契丹再來救援。糧道是雙方真正的勝負點：宋軍必須保證糧車不斷，北漢則屢求契丹運糧接濟，兩條線的長短，直接決定了城牆內外誰先耗盡。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of this war was to strike the relief army first and the isolated city afterwards. Leaving Jinyang, the Song army did not rush straight at Taiyuan; it first met the Khitan relief force at Baigu, where the infantry formed up in squares while crossbowmen and archers opened with a simultaneous volley, the cavalry holding the centre and the two flanks closing in, followed by pursuit of the broken enemy along the valley roads until they gave up all contact with Northern Han. With the relief gone, the Song divided its forces to encircle Jinyang, building wooden palisades and digging trenches on all four sides to cut the city off from the outside, while separate camps were placed to the north and east of the city to protect the grain convoy coming up from Hedong. The siege was run on several tracks at once: trebuchets went first, throwing stones at the gate towers and the defenders on the wall; scaling ladders and saps were brought up against the curtain; and by far the most laborious work was the tunnel dug at the foot of the wall, driven forward on timber shores with earth packed along both sides into a passage fit for troops to move through, the records noting that the digging at the base of the wall took tens of days to complete. On the defensive side the city was closed and held stubbornly, bows and crossbows beating off the ladders, thrown stones smashing the machines, night sorties striking the camps, all in the hope of holding out until the Khitan came again. The supply line was the true hinge of the contest: the Song had to keep the grain carts moving, while Northern Han repeatedly begged the Khitan to send in provisions, and the length of those two lines decided who ran out of strength first inside and outside the walls.
data: 可用的數字不多，且多屬史書的概數，須打折看待。時間上，此役自太平興國四年二月出師，至五月城破，前後約四個月；其中合圍之後的攻城又歷兩閱月。北漢的疆域通常記為山西北部五州（汾、嵐、忻、代、蔚，另有隆州之說），軍力自稱「三萬餘」，然其中州縣鄉兵與臨時徵發者佔多數，戰力遠低於此數。宋軍兵眾多記為十餘萬，但這個數字包括各州團兵、禁軍、隨軍工匠與轉運糧草的徭夫，實際作戰部隊當遠少於此。柏谷一役，契丹援軍兵數諸說並存，有記為四萬；宋軍破之，斬首萬餘級、獲馬萬餘匹的數字亦出自概括性記載，歷來學者多認為有誇大成分。攻城方面可數之資主要是時間：宋軍在城根掘地道，自進兵至開通歷數十日，圍城期間四面木柵連成一片，糧道長達數百里的說法常見於後人敘述。戰後宋廷接收北漢五州之地與官民，北漢國祚自951年至979年，共二十九年。
dataEn: Few usable figures survive for this war, and most of them are the general estimates of the historians and have to be discounted. As to time, the campaign ran from the departure of the army in the second month of Taiping Xingguo 4 to the fall of the city in the fifth month, about four months in all, of which the siege proper after the blockade had closed lasted another two months or so. Northern Han's territory is usually given as five prefectures of northern Shanxi (Fen, Lan, Xin, Dai and Yu, with some accounts adding Long), and its troops numbered, by its own claim, more than thirty thousand; but prefectural militia and hastily levied men made up the greater part of that figure, and its fighting worth was far lower. The Song force is commonly recorded at over a hundred thousand, yet that number swallows provincial militia, imperial guards, craftsmen on campaign and the corvée porters who moved the grain, and the actual fighting contingent must have been much smaller. At Baigu the numbers of the Khitan relief army are given variously, one figure being forty thousand; the Song annals credit the battle with cutting off more than ten thousand heads and taking more than ten thousand horses, a summary-style account which most scholars hold to be exaggerated. The one thing that can be counted with confidence on the siege side is time: digging the tunnel at the foot of the wall took tens of days from the start of the advance until it was driven through, the palisade ran unbroken around the whole circuit, and the grain road is said to have stretched several hundred li. After the war the Song took over five prefectures with their officials and people, and the state of Northern Han had lasted twenty-nine years, from 951 to 979.
cause: 北漢的存在是五代十國分裂的尾聲，也是北宋統一路上最後一個內部障礙。951年後晉滅亡，劉崇在太原自立，仍用漢國號，與中原朝廷長期對抗；北漢疆域逼仄、糧秣不足，幾乎全部倚賴契丹輸粟，方能維持近三十年不亡。976年趙光義即位後，宋廷先平南唐、再於太平興國三年（978）滅北周，把北漢最後的屏障拆掉，北方自此只剩這一個割據政權。直接導火線是北漢倚契丹之勢拒不歸附，屢遣使議和而不得朝廷諒解，宋廷則以「先平北漢、統一中原」為既定次第。太平興國四年正月，趙光義下詔預備兵糧、檢校將士，二月御駕出師，意在趁河東未至隆冬、契丹援軍未及集結的空隙，一舉拔除晉陽。北漢一方也非全無應手：劉繼元一面遣使向宋乞和，一面急向契丹求援，雙方都清楚，一旦開打，晉陽這座城與北方最後的一個政權，只容得下一個。
causeEn: The survival of Northern Han was the tail end of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms division and the last internal obstacle on the Northern Song's road to unification. When Later Jin fell in 951, Liu Chong set himself up at Taiyuan, kept the Han title, and for long stood in defiance of the Central Plain court. Northern Han's territory was cramped and its grain insufficient, so it leaned almost wholly on Khitan deliveries and managed to hold on for close to thirty years. After Zhao Guangyi came to the throne in 976, the Song first destroyed Southern Tang and then, in 978, wiped out Northern Zhou, taking away the last screen behind Northern Han; from then on this lone rump state was all that stood between the Song and the north. The immediate spark was that Northern Han, leaning on Khitan power, refused to submit and repeatedly sent envoys to negotiate without obtaining the court's understanding, while the Song had already fixed the order of business: Northern Han first, then a unified Central Plain. In the first month of Taiping Xingguo 4 Zhao Guangyi issued the edict to gather troops and stores and review the commanders, and in the second month he took the field in person, meaning to seize the moment before deep winter closed the Hedong roads and before the Khitan could concentrate their relief army, and to pull Jinyang out in one stroke. Northern Han was not without answers either: Liu Jiyuan sent envoys to beg for peace while urgently appealing to the Khitan, and both sides understood that once the fighting began, Jinyang and the last state in the north could only be held by one of them.
impact: 此役的結果，是五代十國分裂局面在中原一側的最後收束：北漢滅亡，北宋取得河東五州，自洛陽到太原的北方國土連成一線，國號之下再無第二個漢人政權。此後宋的國策由「先南後北」轉為以北方防禦為主，太原、府州一線被設為邊鎮，河東民戶被編入軍籍，屯田與渠堰水利同時整頓，劉繼元等降將授官居京，成為朝廷對北方新附之地施政的象徵。然而真正的代價在北面：北漢既亡，契丹失去了在中原北方的代理人與緩衝，遼廷隨即以宋「攻屬國」為由出兵南下。太平興國四年五月北漢城破不久，遼軍便大舉南下，六月高梁河之役宋太宗親征大敗而中箭，兵至滿城再與宋軍遭遇，宋軍得勝而遼軍退。從這一年起，宋遼之間長期、全面、又時斷時續的邊戰正式開始，宋廷由進取轉為守禦，「守內虛外」成為此後數十年的基本國策。
impactEn: The effect of this war was the final closing of the Five Dynasties division on the Central Plain side. With the fall of Northern Han, the Northern Song took the five prefectures of Hedong, and the northern territories from Luoyang to Taiyuan ran into one unbroken line; under one title there was no longer a second Han-ruled state. From then on the policy of the Song turned from first the south and then the north to a strategy centred on northern defence: Taiyuan and the Fuzhou line were made into frontier garrisons, the people of Hedong were enrolled into the military registers, and settlement farms, canals and weirs were put in order at the same time; Liu Jiyuan and other surrendered commanders were given office in the capital and became the visible sign of how the court governed the newly attached lands of the north. The real price, however, lay to the north. Once Northern Han was gone the Khitan lost both their agent and their buffer on the northern Central Plain, and the Liao court promptly advanced the grievance that the Song had attacked a vassal state. Hardly had the city of Northern Han fallen in the fifth month of Taiping Xingguo 4 than the Liao army marched south in force. In the sixth month, at Gaolianghe, the emperor's own army was defeated and he was struck by an arrow; later, at Mancheng, the Liao met Song troops again and were beaten back. From that year the long, comprehensive and intermittent border war between Song and Liao began in earnest, and the Song court, having turned from advance to defence, adopted a basic policy of securing the interior while the exterior went empty for years to come.
result: 太平興國四年五月，晉陽城破，劉繼元率官屬出降，北漢至此亡國，其國祚自951年劉崇建國至979年，凡二十九年，領土盡入北宋。處置上，劉繼元授檢校太尉、封鄭王，徙居京師；北漢舊臣舊將降者量材授職，一部分仍被起用於北方邊鎮；太原一城改為宋軍重鎮，軍官、州吏、版籍、倉儲逐一接管，晉陽城防重加修整。對宋太宗而言，此役是他即位以來最乾淨的一場軍事勝利：外援既絕、孤城自降，無大敗亦無大捷，但自此天下只餘一朝，北宋完成對中原及北方的統一。對契丹而言，北漢的覆亡則是一場外交與地緣上的失敗：宗主國被廢、屬土被吞，直接刺激蕭太后與遼廷作出軍事反應。公元979年後，宋遼戰線便在今河北、山西一線拉開，同年高梁河宋軍失利、滿城一役宋軍得手，雙方自此在邊境上反覆拉鋸，一個統一的中原王朝與一個以北亞草原為根基的帝國，正面相持。
resultEn: In the fifth month of Taiping Xingguo 4 the city of Jinyang fell and Liu Jiyuan came out of the gates with his officials and surrendered; Northern Han was thereby extinguished, its state having lasted twenty-nine years from the founding by Liu Chong in 951, and all its territory passed to the Northern Song. In the arrangements that followed, Liu Jiyuan was made Grand Commander of the Palace and enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng and was moved to the capital; the surrendered officials and generals of Northern Han were given posts according to their abilities, some of them being used again on the northern frontier; the single city of Taiyuan became a major garrison of the Song, with the military officers, prefectural officials, household registers and stores taken over one by one and the defences of Jinyang thoroughly repaired. To Zhao Guangyi this was the cleanest military victory of his reign: the foreign aid cut off, the isolated city surrendering of its own accord, no great defeat and no great triumph, and yet from that day there was only one dynasty left under heaven, so that the Northern Song had completed the unification of the Central Plain and the north. To the Khitan, on the other hand, the fall of Northern Han was a diplomatic and geopolitical reverse: the overlord state was scrapped and the client land swallowed, which at once drove the Empress Dowager and the Liao court to answer with troops. After 979 the Song-Liao line was drawn in what is now Hebei and Shanxi; in that same year the Song were worsted at Gaolianghe but won at Mancheng, and from then on the two powers pulled at each other along the frontier, a unified Central Plain dynasty and an empire rooted in the northern Eurasian steppe standing face to face.
